tasks: Record input/output voltages, current, frequency, and active load percentage.
Check LCD alarm log for transient spikes and bypass warnings.
Inspect battery terminal connections for signs of corrosion or leakage.
Perform infrared thermographic scan of AC/DC connection lugs and breakers.
acceptanceCriteria: Warming < 10°C above ambient; no corrosion; load balance within 10% across phases.
safetyPrecautions: Strictly follow electrical Arc Flash PPE guidelines. Never disconnect DC battery strings while under inverter load.

tasks: Check engine lube oil level, coolant level, and day-tank fuel oil level.
Check jacket water heater operation (engine block must feel warm).
Inspect starter lead-acid battery voltage and electrolyte specific gravity.
Perform 15-minute engine no-load test run and observe oil pressure buildup.
acceptanceCriteria: Lube oil at full mark; coolant > 45°C; battery voltage >= 25.4VDC standby; oil pressure > 45 PSI within 5 seconds.
safetyPrecautions: Ensure exhaust area is clear of personnel. Do not open radiator pressure cap when engine is hot.

tasks: Analyze refrigerant pressure, oil level, and compressor vibration readings.
Record condenser and evaporator approach temperatures.
Inspect VSD cooling fan operation and clean internal air intake filters.
Test emergency shutoff interlocks and oil heater circuits.
acceptanceCriteria: Condenser approach <= 1.5°C; oil color clean amber; vibration within ISO vibration velocity thresholds.
safetyPrecautions: Ensure refrigerant leak alarm panel is monitored. Verify mechanical room exhaust ventilation is fully functional.

tasks: Verify cylinder storage pressure on all high-pressure container gauges.
Conduct ultrasonic liquid level measurement to compute clean agent weight.
Inspect flexible discharge hoses for kinks, cuts, and aging cracks.
Check room door sweeps and ceiling penetration caulking for enclosure integrity.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressure within green zone (at 21°C); agent weight loss not exceeding 5% of original stamped weight.
safetyPrecautions: Fit mechanical lockout travel pins onto solenoid valves before touching cylinders.

tasks: Conduct insulation resistance (Megger) test at 5kV on vacuum interrupters.
Perform contact resistance (Micro-ohmmeter) test on primary poles.
Check charging motor mechanism, limit switches, and mechanical latching.
Clean bushings with isopropyl alcohol and check earthing bus continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Insulation resistance > 1000 Mega-ohms; Contact resistance < 45 micro-ohms per pole.
safetyPrecautions: Lock-Out Tag-Out (LOTO) certified isolation, verify zero voltage with HT tester, install protective portable ground leads.
